Cross-scene ratios are NOT quoted from those two columns - they change scene and style together (KB Decision 40); the controlled measurement is Decision 39's, where gouache held identical in prompt, parameters and seed rose 0.0512 to 0.0907 on the enriched scene. Chosen over the higher-intensity cel_bold (s0.55/g9.0/c1.5), which passed a stratified 81-frame probe 0/81 and then failed 36 of 990: a stronger style emits 2500-2900 strong edges per frame instead of 200-700, so a fraction land unsupported across the whole session rather than clustering. This config was instead selected on those 36 empirically-hard frames (0/36, worst spurious 0.063). Denoise strength is held at 0.50 deliberately: raising it is what reintroduces the hallucinated geometry Decision 32 lowered it to stop. No controlled run isolates prompt contrast from the controlnet 1.3->1.6 change or from strength 0.45->0.50, so no causal split between them is claimed here.
